method: Preserved source event metadata from round123 candidate packs.
Tried the prior Planning Portal application polygon endpoint pattern; sample endpoint returned HTTP 404, so planning records were geocoded by public address/site context.
Used Nominatim/OpenStreetMap for address, street, named-site, or postcode-level points when exact official coordinates were unavailable.
Used Food Standards Agency FHRS API coordinates for Harberton North Special School because it exposes a public official geocode for the named establishment.
Excluded records that still lacked a defensible single Belfast point or where the source intentionally withheld exact location.

excluded_examples.reason: Multi-site record and Brae Valley House point not resolved; no defensible single geometry.
Source intentionally keeps exact Remote Evidence Centre location undisclosed; not geocoded.
Campus-wide/multi-building refurbishment; omitted to keep this pack focused on previous missing-geometry or single-site candidates.
